source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: كان عندي امتحان مهم يوم الاتنين.
sentences.en: I had an important exam on Monday.
I studied all week and slept little.

sentences.ar: ليلة الامتحان، ما قدرت أنام من التوتر.
sentences.en: The night of the exam, I couldn't sleep from the stress.
In the morning, I drank coffee and reviewed a little.

sentences.ar: لما وصلت المدرسة، كل الطلاب كانوا خايفين.
sentences.en: When I got to school, all the students were scared.
The teacher handed out the questions and said 'begin.'

sentences.ar: بالأول، حسيت إني نسيت كل شي.
sentences.en: At first, I felt I had forgotten everything.

sentences.ar: بس بعد شوي، هديت وتذكرت الدروس.
sentences.en: But after a while, I calmed down and remembered the lessons.
I finished the exam and came out relieved.

sentences.ar: بعد أسبوع، طلعت النتيجة وكنت من الأوائل.
sentences.en: After a week, the results came out and I was among the top.
